name: Chatha Foods Ltd
summary: Chatha Foods Ltd., an Indian company established in 1997 and headquartered in Chandigarh, is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of frozen and ready-to-eat food items. Under its "Tempter" and "The Field Grill" brand names, the company offers a varied selection of non-vegetarian, vegetarian, and plant-based products. Their extensive range encompasses snacks and sides like chicken wings, nuggets, tenders, fries, and kebabs, as well as chicken and burger patties, sausages, cold cuts, and specialized toppings or fillers such as chicken/lamb pepperoni. They also supply chicken keema and smoked chicken breast. Chatha Foods primarily caters to quick-service restaurants, casual dining establishments, and various segments within the hotel, restaurant, and catering (HORECA) industry.
